headline: Fire Destroys Four Calangute Beach Shacks
summary: A fire gutted four beach shacks in Calangute, causing damage to the properties. Authorities have announced compensation for the affected shack owners.

headline: Four Beach Shacks Gutted in Goa Fire
summary: Four beach shacks were destroyed in a fire in Goa, but no injuries were reported. Emergency response crews monitored the situation following the blaze.

headline: Calangute Shack Fire Causes Rs 1.4 Crore Loss
summary: A massive fire gutted four beach shacks in Goa, resulting in an estimated loss of Rs 1.4 crore for the owners. No casualties were reported in the incident.

headline: Cockroach Janta Party to Launch Goa Campaign
summary: The Cockroach Janta Party is set to launch its 'Kya Bolti Public' campaign from Goa on November 22. The initiative aims to connect with citizens on public issues.

headline: CJP Invites Public Issues for New Campaign
summary: The Cockroach Janta Party will launch its 'Challa Kitem, Goa' campaign on November 22. The party is inviting citizens to flag local issues and concerns.

headline: CJP Schedules 'Challa Kitem Goa' Public Meet
summary: The Cockroach Janta Party has scheduled a public meet titled 'Challa Kitem Goa' for November 22. The event will focus on engaging with the public.

headline: Goa Allows Shops and Malls to Operate 24/7
summary: The Goa government has permitted commercial shops and malls to stay open 24 hours a day. The move aims to boost trade and business activity in the state.

headline: 24-Hour Operations Approved for Goa Retail Outlets
summary: Shops and shopping malls across Goa are now allowed to operate around the clock. The decision provides flexibility to commercial establishments and shoppers.

headline: Goa Permits Round-the-Clock Shopping
summary: Malls and retail shops in Goa can now remain open for 24 hours. The state policy allows commercial hubs to function non-stop.

headline: 12-Year-Old Boy Booked for Assault in Bardez
summary: Police in Bardez have booked a 12-year-old boy for allegedly sexually assaulting a four-year-old girl. Legal proceedings have been initiated regarding the incident.

headline: Minor Booked in Goa Sexual Assault Case
summary: A minor boy has been booked by Goa police following allegations of sexual assault against a young girl. An investigation into the case is underway.

headline: POCSO Case Registered Against Minor Boy in Goa
summary: Goa police registered a POCSO case against an 11-year-old boy for allegedly sexually assaulting a 5-year-old girl. Authorities are handling the matter under child protection laws.

headline: Motorist Shares Bangalore to Goa Road Trip Route
summary: A driver completed a round trip between Bangalore and Goa in a BMW 3 Series using a longer, alternate route. The traveler described the route as offering a better driving experience.

headline: Exhibition Highlights Traditions of Goa's Tribal Communities
summary: A new exhibition documents and showcases the rich cultural traditions of three tribal communities in Goa. The event aims to highlight local indigenous heritage.

headline: IFFI Celebrates Global Cinema in Goa
summary: The International Film Festival of India (IFFI) in Goa features a diverse lineup under the theme of films without borders. Film enthusiasts are attending screenings across the state.

headline: Goa Home Guard Recruitment Announced for 176 Posts
summary: The Goa Home Guard has released an official recruitment notification for 176 positions in 2026. Interested candidates must submit their applications offline.

headline: New Vande Bharat Express Connects Bengaluru to Goa
summary: India's newest Vande Bharat Express offers a 13-hour scenic rail journey connecting Bengaluru, Mangaluru, and Madgaon in Goa. Details on fares, routes, and stops have been released.

headline: 24 Goa Beaches Selected for Turtle Protection
summary: Authorities in Goa have earmarked 24 beaches across the state to provide dedicated protection for sea turtles. The initiative aims to safeguard nesting environments.

headline: Goa Malls and Shops Granted 24-Hour Permission
summary: Commercial shops and shopping malls in Goa are now permitted to remain open 24 hours daily. The official details outline operational guidelines for businesses.

headline: Historic 500-Year-Old Palace Faces Neglect in Goa
summary: A centuries-old palace in Goa that saw multiple historical rulers is currently suffering from neglect. Preservation advocates are calling attention to its deteriorating state.

headline: FDA Cracks Down on Unlicensed Goa Chicken Supplier
summary: The Food and Drugs Administration in Goa took enforcement action against an unlicensed chicken supplier. The crackdown aims to ensure food safety standards across the state.

headline: Tiger Sighted in Mhadei Basin After Two Years
summary: A tiger was spotted in the Mhadei basin for the first time in two years. The sighting has renewed calls from conservationists to establish a formal tiger reserve.

headline: Kushavati District Offices Still Operating from Margao
summary: Despite Kushavati district being formally notified in January, its administrative offices continue to function out of Margao. Residents await the relocation of official operations.

headline: Goa Approves Schemes to Preserve Ancient Manuscripts
summary: The Goa government has approved new schemes to digitise and preserve ancient manuscripts. The initiative aims to protect the state's historical documentary heritage.

headline: IFFI Introduces 'Films About Films' Section
summary: The International Film Festival of India has introduced a new section titled 'Films About Films'. The segment highlights stories and documentaries focused on filmmakers.

headline: Driver Arrested for Illegal Sewage Dumping in Goa
summary: Goa authorities seized a van and arrested its driver for illegally dumping sewage in an unapproved location. Law enforcement took action following civic health concerns.

headline: IFFI Opening Film to Screen Across Multiple Venues
summary: For the first time, the opening film of IFFI will be screened across multiple venues simultaneously for all delegates. The move expands access for festival attendees.

headline: Deficit Rainfall Causes Rs 18.7 Lakh Crop Loss in Goa
summary: A monsoon rainfall deficit has led to an estimated crop loss of Rs 18.7 lakh in Goa, with Sanquelim reported as the worst-affected area.

headline: Goa Heritage Sites Set for Clean-Up Drive
summary: Authorities plan to initiate a comprehensive clean-up drive across heritage sites in Goa starting mid-December. The initiative focuses on restoring cleanliness around historical landmarks.

headline: CJP Leaders to Host Youth Meeting on November 22
summary: Leaders from the Cockroach Janta Party, including Dipke, Das, and Ranka, will host a youth meet in Goa on November 22. The meeting aims to engage young citizens in political dialogue.

headline: Comba Wells Face Neglect Amid Unresolved Sewage Concerns
summary: Residents in Comba express frustration as sewage problems near local wells remain unaddressed, with official site inspections still pending rescheduling.

headline: Goa Releases QR-Enabled Guide to 507 Bird Species
summary: A new QR code-enabled guide featuring 507 bird species has been launched to document Goa's avian population. The digital resource helps enthusiasts identify and learn about local birds.

headline: Goa Cabinet Allocates Rs 10 Crore for AI Policy
summary: The Goa cabinet approved five new schemes under its Artificial Intelligence policy with a budget sanction of Rs 10 crore. The funds will support technological initiatives in the state.

headline: Family Completes 2,200 km Road Trip to Goa and Udupi
summary: A family completed a 2,200 km road trip traveling from Mumbai to Goa and Udupi in a Mitsubishi Cedia. The journey highlighted scenic highway routes along the coast.

headline: Green Brigade Warns IFFI Lighting May Harm Heritage Trees
summary: Environmental group Green Brigade expressed concern that decorative lighting installed for IFFI could cause damage to heritage trees. They urged organizers to protect the trees.

headline: GCCI Welcomes 24-Hour Shopping Approval in Goa
summary: The Goa Chamber of Commerce and Industry welcomed the government's decision to permit 24-hour shopping operations. The body expects the move to boost commercial activity.

headline: Goa Cabinet Approves Audio Visual Archives Scheme
summary: The Goa Cabinet has approved an Audio Visual Archives Scheme to preserve the oral history of the state. The project focuses on recording historical accounts digitally.

headline: Bicholim Farmers Demand Compensation for Mining Damage
summary: Farmers in Bicholim are seeking official relief and compensation for agricultural land damaged by mining activities. They highlighted losses suffered due to environmental impacts.

headline: Bengaluru-Madgaon Vande Bharat Express Line Announced
summary: A new Vande Bharat Express connecting Bengaluru to Madgaon in Goa will take 13 hours to cover the coastal route, offering scenic views for travelers.

headline: Transport Issues Delay Zinc Waste Clearance in Cuncolim
summary: Efforts to clear toxic zinc waste in Cuncolim hit a bottleneck due to transport complications. Local authorities are working to resolve the logistical delays.

headline: Calangute Fire Destroys Four Beach Shacks
summary: Four beach shacks were gutted in a severe fire at Calangute beach in Goa. State authorities have announced financial relief for the affected owners.

headline: Dry Spell Causes Crop Losses for 220 Goa Farmers
summary: A dry weather spell has resulted in crop damage for 220 farmers across Goa. Affected agricultural workers have submitted reports to local authorities.

headline: Curpem Residents Object to Proposed Iron Ore Mine
summary: Local residents of Curpem voiced strong opposition to a proposed iron ore mining project during a public hearing. Concerns were raised regarding environmental and social impacts.

headline: Grease Traps Made Mandatory for All Goa Eateries
summary: Local authorities in Goa have mandated the installation of grease traps for all food establishments and eateries. The rule aims to prevent drainage clogs and pollution.

headline: Man Sentenced to 12 Years for 2018 Palolem Rape
summary: A man from Chennai has been sentenced to 12 years in prison for raping a British tourist in Palolem in 2018. The ruling concludes a multi-year judicial process.

headline: South Goa Collector Pushes to Resolve CRZ Cases
summary: The South Goa Collector has instructed officials to expedite clearances and resolve pending Coastal Regulation Zone (CRZ) cases.

headline: Massive Fire Sweeps Through Calangute Shacks
summary: A fire broke out along Calangute beach, destroying four shacks completely. Firefighters managed to contain the blaze before further spread.

headline: Benaulim Fishermen Await Land as Police Station Moves
summary: Fishermen in Benaulim continue waiting for land allocations as plans for a local police station move forward.

headline: Teacher Arrested for Harassing Minor Student in Bicholim
summary: Goa police arrested a school teacher in Bicholim for alleged stalking and harassment of a minor student. Action was taken following a complaint filed by the victim's family.

headline: FRRO Cracks Down on Illegal Foreign Workers in Goa
summary: The Foreigners Regional Registration Office (FRRO) intensified enforcement actions against foreign nationals working illegally without valid permits in Goa.
